title: The Discovery That Became Possible
case: Unexpected deaths of leading scientists and collaborators' output
claim_tested: Interrupting an established knowledge network changes what its surviving members can produce.
design: Matched scientist-network change comparison, frozen collaborators and matches selected before death; star-specific calendar windows and matched-set fixed effects.
identification_limits: Illness anticipation, grants, and personnel moves may confound effects
Tests knowledge dependence, not simultaneous relativity discovery or its thermodynamic cause
